$schema: AZAR Design System — machine-readable tokens. Authoritative numeric source; see /docs/ui/design-system.md for rationale and usage rules. Do not edit values here without updating design-system.md to match.

meta.name: AZAR Design System
meta.foundation: Material Design 3 structure (https://m3.material.io/), custom "Minimal Luxury" palette/shape/elevation
meta.changeLog: v2.6.0: Phase 2 CRM workflow redesign (Matching/Deal/Reminder/Contract, design-system.md §17) — Matching Workspace with honest (non-fabricated) match scoring via a new MatchingResult component; Deal Pipeline compacted from 9 real stages to 4 visual groups + 2 terminals via PipelineIndicator; Deal/Contract/Reminder detail screens gained a Next Action block and ContextHeader for cross-entity orientation; the Activity timeline pattern (previously Dashboard-only) was relocated to a shared ActivityTimeline component reused by Property/Applicant/Deal/Contract instead of being reimplemented per entity. No new large-amount money-input pattern was added — the existing MoneyInput scale chips already cover it. No schema/status-value changes. v2.5.0: Professional CRM redesign — 8 design principles (design-system.md §0.2) formalized; new Status System (§6.5) with a 5-tone StatusBadge component reusing existing color roles (no new hex), plus real derived status for properties/applicants (reads existing Deal/Reminder data, no schema change); Dashboard restructured into a command-center section order with a new 'Needs Attention' section ranked above Primary Actions (§14); component tokens gained a `statusBadge` entry. No color/type/spacing base values changed — this is architecture + composition, not a palette change. v2.4.0: the v2.3.0 alignSelf fix for the RTL Text-box-shrink bug (design-system.md §10) was only applied to the ~10 files visible in one screenshot review, not app-wide — the bug was still reported after v2.3.0 shipped because dozens of other standalone Text nodes (list screens, empty/error states, dialogs, shared components) had the identical defect and were never audited. v2.4.0 fixes it exhaustively across every file in src/ that renders a standalone block-level Text inside a column container, and hardens §10's wording to state explicitly that the rule is app-wide and must be checked file-by-file, not screen-by-screen. No color/type/shape/spacing values changed. v2.3.0: fixed a real shipped bug — every short field-label Text (design-system.md §10's new mandatory alignSelf rule) was rendering flush-left despite textAlign:'right', because a short Text in a column flex container does not reliably stretch to full width; documented the fix as a mandatory pattern. Also: removed prescriptive per-screen icon-glyph mapping from §6 (icon choice now governed by rules, not a docs catalogue); added §16 Navigation Architecture (one tab owns each screen, no more full-stack duplication across all 5 tabs); §7.2.1/§7.2.2 codify the money-chip (million/billion only, digit-group labels) and search-includes-price rules. v2.2.0: neutral-palette swap — warm ivory/near-black-warm-ink neutrals (background #FAF8F5, primary #1C1B19) replaced with a cool off-white-gray + charcoal-black neutral scale (background #F6F6F7, primary #1E1E20) per explicit user direction. Only the ink/surface neutral family changed; the two brand accents (secondary bronze #8A6D3B, tertiary emerald #2F4F3E) and all semantic colors (error/success/warning/info) are unchanged. v2.1.0: layout-hardening pass — v2.0.0 defined color/type/shape but left page layout, RTL overflow safety, and phone-width responsive behavior as unwritten convention, which let the Dashboard KPI grid ship with a minWidth-driven flex-wrap that silently collapses to 1 column (huge near-empty cards) on any device <=390px wide. Adds named `layout` tokens (screen padding, section/component spacing), a `statCardGrid` component contract (fixed-column, not minWidth-threshold), an `emptyStateCompact` variant, and phone breakpoints (320-430) alongside the existing tablet/desktop `grid` block. No color/type/shape/radius/elevation values changed. v2.0.0: full visual reset — "Minimal Luxury" direction (warm-neutral ivory/ink surfaces + two restrained accents replacing the old cool-gray/near-black Material-generated palette), rounder shape scale, softer/larger-blur elevation, more generous card padding and RTL line-heights. Every token key name is unchanged from v1.1.0 so the change is a value swap, not a schema change. v1.1.0: FINAL UI correction pass before Phase 4 — distinct `warning` token separated from `error`; `iconButton` corrected from a 40px visual size with a merely 'recommended' 48dp hit area to a mandatory 48dp hit area around an unenlarged icon; `color.dark` remains explicitly deferred (unchanged, not populated).

dark.$status: NOT DEFINED — flagged gap, see design-system.md §11. No dark palette has been designed. Do not populate this object with guessed values; a dedicated dark-palette design pass is required first.

notes.success: A distinct deep-emerald hue, deliberately separate from `tertiary` even though both are green-family — `success` is a semantic/functional signal (operation succeeded, positive money state) while `tertiary` is a brand accent; keeping them independently editable matters more than sharing one value would save.
notes.warning: Use `warning`/`warning-container` for non-fatal caution states — contract approaching expiration, reminder-related caution, restore-flow warnings before the destructive commit step. Reserve `error`/`error-container` strictly for genuine failures — failed operations, invalid input, corrupted data, authentication failure, the destructive commit action itself. See design-system.md §1.
notes.info: Independent slate-blue hue — no longer aliased to `tertiary` (that alias predates the v2.0.0 palette and no longer makes sense now that `tertiary` is the brand emerald accent).

Geist.role: headings, labels, buttons (LTR) — not yet bundled, falls back to system font

Inter.role: body copy (LTR) — not yet bundled, falls back to system font

Vazirmatn.role: all text (RTL/Persian) — bundled, the only typeface actually shipped

AZAR Icon Set.role: iconography, all contexts; zero-dependency pure-View composition, see design-system.md §6

phoneBreakpoints.$comment: AZAR ships on phones only (see design-system.md §13) — these are the required regression-test widths, not a separate column system. Every screen must render with zero horizontal overflow at all six.

iconButton.note: Every icon-only interactive control uses a 48dp x 48dp minimum interactive container regardless of the visual icon's own size; the icon itself is never enlarged to fill the container.

statCardGrid.note: KPI/stat rows are a FIXED 2-column percentage grid, never a minWidth-threshold flex-wrap — see design-system.md §13. A minWidth-based row (e.g. minWidth:140 + flex:1 in a flexWrap row) collapses to 1 column below ~390px content width and produces oversized near-empty cards; columnBasisPercent (46%, not 50%, to leave headroom for `gap` between the two columns — RN's `gap` adds to percentage widths rather than being subtracted from them) guarantees exactly 2 per row at every phone width in `phoneBreakpoints`, including the narrowest (320px). Card height is content-driven (no minHeight).

emptyStateCompact.note: Used when an EmptyState is nested inside an existing page section (e.g. a dashboard sub-section) rather than filling the whole screen — the full space-8/icon-xl variant is reserved for screen-level empty states so a one-line 'nothing here yet' message doesn't dominate the page (see design-system.md §7.7/§15).
